headline: Kylym Bank and StoneX Group signed a memorandum of cooperation
summary: Kyrgyzstan's Kylym Bank and StoneX Group signed a memorandum of cooperation. The signing was held to implement tasks set by the country's top leadership, with assistance from the presidential administration's affairs office.
why: StoneX Group is a US-listed financial services firm offering brokerage, clearing and market access, so partnerships with regional banks can expand cross-border financial services.
original_headline: «Кылым Банк» и StoneX Group подписали меморандум о сотрудничестве
